# Appeal of Denial — Lower Back Disc Surgery / Decompression (CPT 63030)

**RE: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated 2026-08-17**
**Member: Reese Carter | Member ID: W769161738**
**Reference Number: POC-9992A0803A-86478**
**Plan: Molina Healthcare (Commercial/ACA), Wisconsin**

To Molina Healthcare Member Appeals:

I am appealing the denial of coverage for lower back disc surgery / decompression (CPT 63030), which was denied in the notice above on the grounds that my documentation was "incomplete" and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am asking Molina to reconsider this decision.

## The Plan Has Not Told Me What Was Missing

The denial notice states that this determination was made "under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria," but it does not name that policy, identify which specific criteria were applied, or explain which piece of documentation was considered incomplete. No specific policy title, section, or guideline was provided to me in the denial letter or in the materials I have been given. I am not able to quote plan criteria that I have not been shown, and I do not believe a fair review can happen without them.

## The Medical Record Molina Received

My surgeon, Dr. Reyes, submitted a prior authorization packet that I understand included the following, and my request is that Molina confirm each of these items was received and reviewed:

- **Symptom duration and severity:** 18 months of progressive lower back pain, unrelieved by rest.
- **Conservative treatment already completed:** 10 weeks of supervised physical therapy (core stabilization and lumbar flexibility), 18 visits, from 2026-04-24 to 2026-07-03, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- **Medication trial:** NSAIDs for 4 months with inadequate relief, and a corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-07 that gave only 3 weeks of partial relief.
- **Imaging findings:** MRI of the lumbar spine on 2026-06-23 showing an L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root.
- **Functional limitation:** I cannot stand for more than 10 minutes without pain radiating into my right calf.
- **Physical exam findings:** positive provocative testing on the affected side, with a neurologic deficit that corresponds to the level shown on the MRI.
- **Other relevant history:** no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI of 29, and I do not smoke.

If any specific document, form, or piece of information was missing from what my surgeon's office submitted, I am asking Molina to identify exactly what is needed so that it can be provided. If the packet described above was received in full, I am asking Molina to explain what additional information is required to complete a medical-necessity review, since my surgeon has documented that this surgery is needed.

## Request for the Criteria Applied to My Case

Molina's own utilization-management materials indicate that the clinical criteria used for determinations (MCG guidelines) are available behind the secure provider portal, and that members may call to obtain the criteria used to make a final determination. I am formally requesting, in writing, **the MCG guideline title and the specific criteria applied to my determination**, so that I and my surgeon can review them and respond directly to whatever standard was used.

## Deadline and Where This Appeal Is Being Sent

I understand that my appeal must be received by **2027-02-13** (180 days from the date of the denial notice). I am submitting this appeal through the Molina member portal at molinahealthcare.com and/or by mail to the appeal address printed on my denial letter, and I am also available by phone at the Member Services number on my ID card if any part of this appeal needs clarification.

## What I Am Asking For

I am asking Molina Healthcare to:

1. Reconsider the denial of CPT 63030 in light of the clinical documentation summarized above;
2. Identify in writing exactly what documentation, if any, was missing or incomplete; and
3. Provide, in writing, the specific MCG guideline title and criteria applied to my case.

Thank you for reviewing this appeal. I understand that this letter does not guarantee a change in the outcome, and I am simply asking that my case be fully and fairly reviewed against the criteria Molina itself uses.

Sincerely,

**Reese Carter**
Member ID: W769161738
[Address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
[Date of submission]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
